cases.title: Validate empty input handling
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Check!' button with an empty input field displays the message '⛔️ No number!' in the game message element.

cases.title: Verify correct guess UI updates and highscore logic
cases.description: Ensure that guessing the correct secret number reveals the number, displays '🎉 Correct Number!', changes the background to '#60b347', expands the hidden number width to '30rem', and updates the highscore if applicable.

cases.title: Evaluate incorrect high and low guesses with score decrement
cases.description: Test that incorrect guesses higher or lower than the secret number display '📈 Too high!' or '📉 Too low!', respectively, and correctly decrement the current score by 1, including boundary values like 1 and 20.

cases.title: Verify game loss state upon score depletion
cases.description: Verify that when the current score reaches 0 after an incorrect guess, the system displays '💥 You lost the game!' and updates the score element to 0.

cases.title: Check persistent range hint visibility
cases.description: Ensure that the valid range hint '(Between 1 and 20)' is continuously displayed near the guess input field and associated with the element having data-testid='range-info'.

cases.title: Verify 'Again!' button resets game state completely
cases.description: Test that clicking the 'Again!' button resets the secret number, sets the score back to 20, clears the input field, resets the hidden number display to '?' with a width of '15rem', and restores the body background color to '#222'.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements completely, and have clear, testable expectations without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-1: Testable behaviors include UI element identification via data-testid ('guess-input', 'check-button', 'game-message', 'current-score', 'hidden-number', 'highscore-value', 'again-button'), empty input validation displaying '⛔️ No number!', comparison with random secret number (1-20) yielding '📈 Too high!', '📉 Too low!', or '🎉 Correct Number!', score decrementing by 1 on incorrect guesses, score reset to 0 on loss, win state UI changes (background color to '#60b347', hidden-number width to '30rem'), highscore updates, and game reset via 'Again!'. Boundaries and normal paths include valid numbers (1-20), while abnormal paths include empty inputs. Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-2: Focuses on the correct guess path, validating exact display messages ('🎉 Correct Number!'), revealing the secret number, body background color update ('#60b347'), hidden number width ('30rem'), and highscore conditional update. Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-3: Evaluates guesses greater than or less than the secret number, confirming messages ('📈 Too high!', '📉 Too low!'), initial score of 20 decrementing by 1, and edge cases like guesses 1 and 20. Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-4: Tests the game loss state when the score reaches 0, verifying message '💥 You lost the game!' and score display of 0 in 'current-score'. Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-5: Requires the constant presence of the valid range hint '(Between 1 and 20)' associated with the element having data-testid='range-info', persisting across window resizes. Requirement e2edev_bench_64-R-6: Details the complete reset functionality triggered by 'again-button': new secret number generated, score reset to 20 ('current-score'), input cleared ('guess-input'), hidden number text reset to '?' ('hidden-number'), body background color reset to '#222', and hidden number width reset to '15rem'.
